title: Hayati Pro Max Banana Ice Nic Salt E-Liquid 10ml
description: Hayati Pro Max Banana Ice delivers the mellow sweetness of ripe Banana with a crisp layer of cooling Menthol. The creamy, smooth banana flavour takes centre stage on the inhale, while the brisk ice note brings a clean contrast that keeps the vape light and refreshing rather than overly rich. Made with nicotine salts, this e-liquid provides faster nicotine absorption, and a more comfortable throat hit than traditional freebase formulations. Blended at a 50VG/50PG ratio, it’s designed for use with low-powered pod kits and MTL (mouth-to-lung) starter devices, delivering discreet vapour and consistent flavour throughout the day. The Hayati Pro Max range includes a wide variety of flavours inspired by the brand’s popular disposable vapes—now available in 10ml bottles for longer-lasting use and better value. With multiple nicotine strengths to choose from, Hayati Pro Max Nic Salts are a smart alternative to single-use vapes.
